sloka: ते शारद अभ्र प्रतिमम् श्रीमत् रजत पर्वतम् ।शृंगवन्तम् दरीवंतम् अधिरुह्य च वानराः ॥४-४९-१६॥
transliteration: te śārada abhra pratimam śrīmat rajata parvatam ।śṛṁgavantam darīvaṁtam adhiruhya ca vānarāḥ ॥4-49-16॥

translations.english: Eager to find Sita, the best of monkeys climbed the silver mountain rich with peaks and caverns resembling the autumnal clouds. And looked out into the Lodhra grove and the garden of seven leaves (banara plantations).
translations.hindi: अब वे वानरगण शारद'य मेघमाला जेपे शोभाग्रुक तथा शिखरों और घाटियों वाले रजत पर्वत पर चढ़ गए
